source_refs.note: Topic 1.14 Network Security as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 19-20, printed 14-15); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: Network security is used to protect computer networks. It keeps data safe from unauthorized access. Security helps prevent data loss and damage. Many users connect to networks daily. Without security, networks become unsafe. Network security uses different tools and rules. It is important for homes and organizations. Network security protects personal and important information. It stops hackers from entering the network. Security keeps data private and safe. It also protects devices from malware. Secure networks work smoothly without interruptions. Every network needs basic security measures.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Discuss how security protects sensitive data like CT scans of patients in a hospital.
